sources.title: NVIDIA/Isaac-GR00T (official code), branch n1d5, commit 4af2b62: README.md, gr00t/experiment/data_config.py, gr00t/data/transform/video.py
sources.covers: VideoCrop(scale=0.95) then VideoResize to 224 × 224, the centre crop in eval mode, action_indices, the inference timing on one H100

note: The N1.5 data configurations (the SO-100 ones included) crop each video frame to 95 % of each side (random in training, torchvision CenterCrop in eval mode) and resize it to 224 × 224 without keeping the aspect ratio. The vision encoder is SigLIP-2 inside Eagle 2.5 (frozen); its patch size and the tokens per frame are not stated in these sources. The number of views varies by embodiment (So100DataConfig: one "video.webcam"; So100DualCamDataConfig: "video.front", "video.wrist"). The README times the full model at 47.88 ms on one H100 (VLM backbone 23.18 ms, action head with 4 diffusion steps 4 × 6.18 ms) and says consumer GPUs such as the RTX 4090 are "slightly slower"; its Thor TensorRT table is per module and was not entered. Licence: the model card's "Nvidia License" (NVIDIA-OneWay-Noncommercial-License-22Mar2022). DexVantage bundles these figures only.
